title: eval-harness: add per-prompt quality gating CI hook and reporting
author: Daniel Kim
description:
Motivation: Add a per-prompt quality gating CI hook to the eval-harness so PRs that introduce regressions for individual prompt-sets fail fast and provide actionable diagnostics. This hooks into existing CI checks and the eval metrics pipeline, provides a lightweight fallback when metrics ingestion is delayed, and ships with a small docs update and tests.

What this PR does: 1) Implements a new CI hook `per_prompt_quality_gate.py` that runs the eval harness on a configured subset of prompt-sets and compares scores against baseline thresholds stored in the eval-metrics bucket. The hook returns a non-zero exit code when any prompt falls below the configured delta threshold. 2) Adds an integration layer to post summarized prompt-level deltas to GitHub Checks with direct links to the full eval report. 3) Adds a safe fallback path: if metrics ingestion is unavailable, the hook runs against the local baseline snapshot committed in `eval-harness/baselines/` and annotates the PR with a warning (not a hard-block) unless the baseline snapshot is explicitly out-of-date. 4) Adds unit/integration tests and CI workflows for the new hook, plus docs and example prompt-sets.

Backward compatibility and safety: The gate is opt-in per-repo via `ci/config/quality_gates.yml` and defaults to disabled for existing repos. The integration respects per-team thresholds and can be overridden by review approvals. We intentionally make metric ingestion failures non-blocking to avoid taking down CI.

Testing performed: Local unit tests, a GitHub Actions run against a synthetic prompt-set (see `ci/tests/test_quality_gate.yml`), and an end-to-end run in the staging CI environment. Initial integration runs surfaced an edge-case race (metrics read while ingestion in-flight) which is handled by a short backoff + fallback to local baseline.

Rollout plan: Merge to main, enable opt-in gate for `redwood` in a follow-up config PR, monitor for false-positives for 2 weeks, and add automatic baseline refresh job in a subsequent change.

Related: ENG-3321 (per-prompt quality gating spec), ENG-3380 (CI checks improvements), SUP-4567 (customer incident that motivated clearer prompt-level failures).

review_thread: Asha Patel (2026-02-21): Overall this is a great improvement. A couple of questions: 1) can we make the threshold config per-prompt-set instead of global? 2) what's the expected runtime impact on PR CI?

Daniel Kim (2026-02-21): For now thresholds are global per-team (to keep config surface small); I'll follow up with a separate change to allow per-prompt-set overrides (ENG-3399). Runtime: we run a sampled subset (configurable) and the workflow caches model artifacts; in our staging runs median added time was ~2.2m.

Marco Li (2026-02-22): Can we make ingestion failures non-blocking? We had an incident where ingestion lag caused noisy failures. Suggested change: fallback to local snapshot and annotate the check as a warning.
Daniel Kim (2026-02-22): Implemented the fallback path and added a short backoff; updated tests to cover the ingestion-lag case.
Sofia Ruiz (2026-02-24): Left a small nits about logging and error messages in the hook; also requested clearer docs for enabling the gate in `ci/config/quality_gates.yml`.
Daniel Kim (2026-02-25): Addressed logging nits and expanded docs. Added an example `ci/config/quality_gates.yml` snippet in the README.
Asha Patel (2026-02-26): Approved after changes. Marco Li (2026-02-27): Approved. Sofia Ruiz (2026-02-27): Approved (minor comments addressed).
